note: AI interaction pattern catalogs collected Nov 20, 2026. Descriptions are short paraphrases or the source's own one-liners; see each source for full text.

patterns.name: Example gallery
patterns.description: Share sample generations, prompts, and parameters to educate and inspire users.

patterns.name: Follow up
patterns.description: Get more information from the user when the initial prompt isn't sufficiently clear.

patterns.name: Initial CTA
patterns.description: Large, open-ended input inviting the user to start their first interaction with the AI.

patterns.name: Nudges
patterns.description: Alert users to actions they can take to use AI, especially if they are just getting started.

patterns.name: Prompt details
patterns.description: Show users what is actually happening behind the scenes.

patterns.name: Randomize
patterns.description: Kickstart the prompting experience with a low bar and fun results

patterns.name: Suggestions
patterns.description: Solves the blank canvas dilemma with clues for how to prompt.

patterns.name: Templates
patterns.description: Structured templates that can be filled by the user or pre-filled by the AI.

patterns.name: Auto-fill
patterns.description: Extend a prompt to multiple fields or inputs at once.

patterns.name: Describe
patterns.description: Decomposes the course into its fundamental tokens and suggested prompt.

patterns.name: Expand
patterns.description: Lengthen the underlying content or add depth and details.

patterns.name: Inline Action
patterns.description: Ask or interact with AI contextually based on something already available on the page.

patterns.name: Inpainting
patterns.description: Target specific areas of the AI's result to regenerate or remix.

patterns.name: Madlibs
patterns.description: Repeatedly run generative tasks without compromising on the format or accuracy.

patterns.name: Open input
patterns.description: Open ended prompt inputs that can be used in AI conversations and other natural language prompting

patterns.name: Regenerate
patterns.description: Have the AI reproduce its response to the prompt without additional input

patterns.name: Restructure
patterns.description: Use existing content as the starting point for prompting.

patterns.name: Restyle
patterns.description: Transfer styles without changing the underlying structure of a generation.

patterns.name: Summary
patterns.description: Have AI distill a topic or resource down to its essence.

patterns.name: Synthesis
patterns.description: Distill or reorganize complicated information into simple structure.

patterns.name: Transform
patterns.description: Use AI to change the modality of content.

patterns.name: Attachments
patterns.description: Give the AI a specific reference to anchor its response.

patterns.name: Connectors
patterns.description: Allow AI to reference external data and context.

patterns.name: Filters
patterns.description: Constrain the inputs or the outputs of the AI by source, type, modality, etc.

patterns.name: Model management
patterns.description: Let users specify what model to use for their prompts.

patterns.name: Modes
patterns.description: Adjust the underlying training, constraints, and persona to a specific context of use.

patterns.name: Parameters
patterns.description: Include constraints with your prompt for the AI to reference when generating its result.

patterns.name: Preset styles
patterns.description: Provide default options to change the texture, aesthetic, or tone of generative media.

patterns.name: Saved styles
patterns.description: Allow users to define their own style presets for re-use.

patterns.name: Voice and tone
patterns.description: Ensure outputs match your voice, tone, and preferences in a consistent way.

patterns.name: Action plan
patterns.description: Have the AI show the steps it will take to respond to the user's prompt before it executes its response

patterns.name: Branches
patterns.description: Support iterative prompting while retaining footprints band visibility back to the original

patterns.name: Citations
patterns.description: Lets the AI give inline annotations to cite its sources

patterns.name: Controls
patterns.description: Manage the flow of information or pause a request mid-stream to adjust the prompt

patterns.name: Cost estimates
patterns.description: Help users proactively modulate compute power through transparent cost estimates for actions

patterns.name: Draft mode
patterns.description: Support exploration and iterative prompting while reducing compute costs until a final form is ready

patterns.name: Memory
patterns.description: Control what details the AI knows about you

patterns.name: References
patterns.description: See and manage what additional sources the AI references to generate its response

patterns.name: Sample response
patterns.description: Confirm the user's intent for complicated prompts

patterns.name: Shared vision
patterns.description: Live visibility into the AI's action in a shared canvas or workspace

patterns.name: Stream of Thought
patterns.description: Reveals the AI's logic thought process, tool use, and decisions for oversight and auditability

patterns.name: Variations
patterns.description: Trace through multiple variations of a result to choose the one that works best for them

patterns.name: Verification
patterns.description: Allow users to confirm AI decisions and actions before proceeding

patterns.name: Caveat
patterns.description: Inform users about shortcomings or risks in the model or the technology overall

patterns.name: Consent
patterns.description: Only capture data from others with their knowledge and permission

patterns.name: Data ownership
patterns.description: Control how the model remembers and uses your data

patterns.name: Disclosure
patterns.description: Clearly mark content and interactions guided or delivered by AI

patterns.name: Footprints
patterns.description: Let users trace the AI's steps from prompt to result

patterns.name: Incognito Mode
patterns.description: Interact with the AI outside of its memory

patterns.name: Watermark
patterns.description: Identifiers on AI Generative content that humans, software, or programs can read

patterns.name: Avatar
patterns.description: Visual identifier of the AI itself to help it be recognizable, memorable, and on-brand.

patterns.name: Color
patterns.description: Visual cues to help users identify AI features or content.

patterns.name: Iconography
patterns.description: Images that represent AI-powered actions throughout the interface.

patterns.name: Name
patterns.description: How the AI is referred to through the product and across the overall customer experience.

patterns.name: Personality
patterns.description: Characteristics that distinguish the AI's personality and vibe.

microsoft_hax.note: Names and one-line descriptions as shown on the HAX Design Library page; phases other than G1 not confirmed from the page.

guidelines.name: Make clear what the system can do
guidelines.description: Help the user understand what the AI system is capable of doing.

guidelines.name: Make clear how well the system can do what it can do
guidelines.description: Help the user understand how often the AI system may make mistakes.

guidelines.name: Time services based on context
guidelines.description: Time when to act or interrupt based on the user's current task and environment.

guidelines.name: Show contextually relevant information
guidelines.description: Display information relevant to the user's current task and environment.

guidelines.name: Match relevant social norms
guidelines.description: Ensure the experience is delivered in a way that users would expect, given their social and cultural context.

guidelines.name: Mitigate social biases
guidelines.description: Ensure the AI system's language and behaviors do not reinforce undesirable and unfair stereotypes and biases.

guidelines.name: Support efficient invocation
guidelines.description: Make it easy to invoke or request the AI system's services when needed.

guidelines.name: Support efficient dismissal
guidelines.description: Make it easy to dismiss or ignore undesired AI system services.

guidelines.name: Support efficient correction
guidelines.description: Make it easy to edit, refine, or recover when the AI system is wrong.

guidelines.name: Scope services when in doubt
guidelines.description: Engage in disambiguation or gracefully degrade the AI system's services when uncertain about a user's goals.

guidelines.name: Make clear why the system did what it did
guidelines.description: Enable the user to access an explanation of why the AI system behaved as it did.

guidelines.name: Remember recent interactions
guidelines.description: Maintain short-term memory and allow the user to make efficient references to that memory.

guidelines.name: Learn from user behavior
guidelines.description: Personalize the user's experience by learning from their actions over time.

guidelines.name: Update and adapt cautiously
guidelines.description: Limit disruptive changes when updating and adapting the AI system's behaviors.

guidelines.name: Encourage granular feedback
guidelines.description: Enable the user to provide feedback indicating their preferences during regular interaction with the AI system.

guidelines.name: Convey the consequences of user actions
guidelines.description: Immediately update or convey how user actions will impact future behaviors of the AI system.

guidelines.name: Provide global controls
guidelines.description: Allow the user to globally customize what the AI system monitors and how it behaves.

guidelines.name: Notify users about changes
guidelines.description: Inform the user when the AI system adds or updates its capabilities.

patterns.name: Living Breadcrumb
patterns.description: Small status line that cycles short updates for low-priority background work.

patterns.name: Dynamic Checklist
patterns.description: Lists every planned step: done, current, pending. For high-stakes multi-step tasks (example: Devin).

patterns.name: Thinking Toggle
patterns.description: A 'View logs' control that expands a status into a sanitized log of calls.

patterns.name: Partial Success
patterns.description: Per-item outcome (success / failed + reason) instead of one binary failure banner.

patterns.name: Disentangling the Tool
patterns.description: Errors name the external service that failed and the retry plan, instead of blaming the AI.

patterns.name: Audit Trail / Show Work
patterns.description: A link or history on the result that replays how it was produced.

patterns.name: Agentic Update Formula
patterns.description: Status copy = action word + specific item + limits/rules.

patterns.name: Real-time activity list
patterns.description: Activities listed and ticked as they complete (example: Perplexity).

patterns.name: Intent Preview
patterns.description: Pause before an irreversible action, explain intent, require confirmation.

patterns.name: Action Audit and Undo
patterns.description: Act, notify, offer immediate undo.

patterns.name: Passive Toast / Log
patterns.description: Subtle notice for low-impact reversible actions.

patterns.name: Review trail
patterns.description: Notification plus review for high-impact reversible actions.

patterns.name: Reviewing Logic state
patterns.description: Pause above a threshold and show the deciding factors first.

patterns.name: Proof of Work
patterns.description: Show the rationale before or as the system acts.

patterns.name: Named step status
patterns.description: Specific step names instead of a generic 'Calculating…'.

patterns.name: Status bar above the document
patterns.description: Specific message tied to the document being reviewed.

anti_patterns: Generic spinner for AI thinking time
Vague status without object or reason
Blaming the AI for an external tool failure
Playful personified tone on high-stakes tasks
